messages:
sophia: Quick sync — HW preview acceptance criteria + benchmark flow for NovaChip EAP. Need signoff before NDA handoff tomorrow. TL;DR: run perf suite, power/thermal check, 99th pct latency <= 45ms, throughput >= 1200 tokens/s, QoR delta <= 0.5% vs our baseline. Thoughts?

kevin: Can we lock the baseline model/version and exact dataset? Also we should define whether throughput is tokens/s or sequences/s.

maria: Baseline: redwood/gpt-jit-v1.2 (quant-int8). Dataset: devbench-2026-small (5k prompts). Throughput = tokens/s.

adam: Ops note — lab has two NovaChip boards available. I can reserve one, but need a day/time. Prefer Mon morning. @infra-bot can you book rack slot?

infra-bot: reservation confirmed — slot reserved on lab-rack-5: 2026-03-30 09:00-17:00 (engineer: adam).

kevin: Acceptance tests for correctness: token-level perplexity <= baseline + 1.0 AND output semantic similarity (embedding cosine) >= 0.98. Add no OOMs during an 8k sequence soak.

sophia: Add power/thermal thresholds: sustained GPU power within +/-5% of baseline for sustained runs, no thermal throttling events. Also require kernel-selection logs for reproducibility.

sam: Telemetry: capture per-request trace, kernel selection, GPU power metrics, and nvml logs. Run with REDWOOD_TELEM=preview_v2 and upload to s3://redwood-preview/novachip/1755556666/. I'll add the ingestion hook.

maria: Run command for bench (shared):

```
./run_bench.sh --model novachip-rtxq-1.0 --dataset devbench-2026-small \
  --seq 2048 --batch 8 --quant int8 --out ./results.json
```

kevin: Make sure to run with cache-warmup=50 and cold-start=5. Also capture 99th pct latency and p99.9 for long-tail.

adam: I'll add a small watchdog to kill run if OOM detected and upload a snippet. Also adding slot for extended 8k soak on Tue if we need it.

sophia: Owners: maria (bench harness + metrics), kevin (acceptance thresholds & eval), adam (lab ops & reservation), sam (telemetry + uploads). Legal: NDA deliverable needs partner-redacted report (no logos, no partner IP).

maria: Plan: run initial perf Mon, aggregate Tue, sync Wed 10:00 PT for signoff. If we pass, we share preliminary under NDA Thurs. If fail, triage Wed afternoon and re-run Thurs.

kevin: One question — baseline is measured on our hosted titanium GPU. Need to ensure environment differences are documented in the report (clock, driver, CUDA version).

sam: Good call. Add fields to telemetry: driver.version, cuda.version, kernel.hash, env.REDWOOD_RUNTIME.

maria: Also adding a short checklist to the doc: run cmd, upload results.json, attach nvml.log, attach power.csv, attach kernel.log, fill the acceptance table.

sophia: Can someone drop the acceptance checklist in a doc and tag reviewers? low-friction.

sam: Done: https://docs.google.com/document/d/preview-acceptance-novachip (internal) — added reviewers: @kevin, @maria, @adam, @sophia.

maria: Thanks — I'll update the doc after the first run. :rocket: 

kevin: One last thing — for visibility, let's add a short summary card for the partner: pass/fail, key numbers, and suggested next steps. We'll scrub before sharing.

sophia: Agreed. If anyone hits blockers, ping me and I'll escalate to partnerships/legal.

adam: On it. See you Monday.

maria: Aiming for clean run. I'll post partial logs in the doc as they land.

kevin: 👍
